name: ai-usage-toggle
description: Switch between account/subscription and API-key usage for Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI from the status bar.

aiUsageToggle.order.markdownDescription: Modes the toggle cycles through, in order. Only modes listed here are enabled. Built-in ids: `claude-max`, `claude-api`, `gemini-account`, `gemini-api`, `openai-account`, `openai-api`. Local instances are `local:<name>`. Account modes clear that provider's key; API modes inject `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, or `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

name.description: Shown in the status bar and lists. The mode id is `p:<name>`.

type.description: account: subscription login; api: a key stored in the credential vault; local: an OpenAI-compatible server.

provider.description: Required for account and api profiles.

configDir.description: Account only: separate login folder, set as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (claude), CODEX_HOME (openai), or GEMINI_CLI_HOME (gemini) so you can keep a second account.

baseUrl.description: Local only: endpoint such as http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama) or http://localhost:1234/v1 (LM Studio).

apiKey.description: Local only: optional placeholder key (defaults to `local`). Plain text in settings, so never a real secret.

env.description: Extra environment variables injected while this profile is active.

icon.description: Optional codicon name for the status bar, e.g. `briefcase`, `home`, `rocket`.

aiUsageToggle.profiles.markdownDescription: Named profiles: add as many accounts, API keys, and local servers as you like. Use **AI Usage: Add Profile** to create one, then they appear in **Choose Modes** and can be ordered in `aiUsageToggle.order`. API keys are stored in the OS credential vault, not here.

aiUsageToggle.clickBehavior.description: What clicking the status bar item does: switch to the next mode, or open a pick list.

aiUsageToggle.sync.sessionLimit.description: How many recent chats to list per tool in the AI Chat Sync view.

aiUsageToggle.sync.maxChars.description: Character budget for a converted chat (rough token cap). Newest turns are kept.
